item.title: Trump and Silicon Valley Pressure Nvidia to Reinstate Jensen Huang
item.description:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was dramatically reinstated less than two weeks after resigning over a scandal, after President Donald Trump pressured the board and Silicon Valley allies lobbied intensively. Backers argued Huang is personally integral to the US AI industry and stock market, but the reversal raises serious questions about corporate governance and the board's judgment.

原文标题：特朗普与硅谷施压 黄仁勋重返英伟达

Why it matters：全球最重要 AI 芯片公司 CEO 在政治与产业力量干预下闪电复职，是观察 AI 产业与政商关系的关键事件。

Ars Technica AI · industry · signal 78/100

item.title: Anthropic Researcher Defends AI-Assisted Riemann Proof Amid Backlash
item.description:
Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge stands by the mathematical validity of his AI-assisted proof of the generalized Riemann hypothesis, whose Lean code has passed formal verification, but concedes multiple rollout missteps: the code was published uncleaned and packed with redundant steps and unnecessary lemmas, and his remarks on the proof's length were meant as a joke. He calls the criticism of his presentation fair and notes that a successful compile alone does not prove the Lean code states the right theorem without hidden assumptions.

原文标题：Anthropic 研究员回应 AI 辅助黎曼证明争议

Why it matters：AI 辅助数学证明是前沿交叉领域，该事件涉及形式化验证的可信边界与发布规范，对关注 AI for Science 的读者有实质参考价值。

item.title: ASRock Industrial and Intel Launch RBK-100 Physical AI Dev Platform
item.description:
ASRock Industrial and Intel have launched RBK-100, a Robotics-in-a-Box platform that bundles a NUC BOX-358H mini PC, an RGB-D depth camera, a six-axis master-slave robotic arm and AiRoboStarter software into an out-of-the-box robotics development kit. It ships with 32GB DDR5 memory (64GB optional) and covers the full workflow from demonstration recording and dataset inspection to model training and skill execution, supporting ACT and Pi0.5 model pipelines.

原文标题：东擎联合英特尔推出物理 AI 开发平台 RBK-100

Why it matters：面向具身智能开发者的软硬一体套件，降低了机器人模仿学习工作流的入门门槛，但属于厂商绑定的集成方案，技术增量有限。

item.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Insiders Doubt Control of Unreleased Models
item.description:
Citing more than two dozen insiders, Axios reports that unreleased frontier models at OpenAI and Anthropic have grown capable enough that many employees no longer believe they can be safely controlled. Both companies are reportedly debating internally whether to delay or halt release, marking a shift from theoretical safety debate to real deployment decisions.

原文标题：OpenAI 与 Anthropic 内部担忧未发布模型失控

Why it matters：这是前沿实验室内部对模型能力超越安全护栏的罕见公开信号，直接关系到下一代模型的发布节奏与行业监管走向。

item.title: Nvidia Shares Fall Over 5% as Huang's Return Rally Fades
item.description:
Nvidia shares fell 5.2% in premarket trading, reversing part of a 31.5% single-day surge that added over $952 billion in market value after Jensen Huang's return as CEO. Investors are now weighing long-term political and legal risks, including board independence and White House interference in corporate governance.

原文标题：英伟达盘前跌超 5% 黄仁勋回归行情熄火

Why it matters：英伟达作为 AI 算力核心标的，其管理层剧变与治理风险直接牵动整个 AI 生态与资本市场情绪。

item.title: Anthropic Shares Slip Below $83 IPO Price in Premarket Trading
item.description:
Anthropic's stock fell below its $83 IPO price in premarket trading, marking the first market stress signal after the frontier model developer went public. The break below the offer price suggests a gap between public-market valuation and private-round expectations, offering a key reference point for other large model companies eyeing listings.

原文标题：Anthropic 上市首日盘前跌破 83 美元发行价

Why it matters：头部大模型公司 IPO 破发是 AI 产业资本化进程的标志性事件，直接影响行业估值锚与后续融资节奏。

item.title: US Data Centers Bypass Grid with 100+ Onsite Gas Plants
item.description:
Grid interconnection approvals can take up to a decade, pushing US data center developers to build their own off-grid natural gas plants, with more than 100 such projects announced as of October 2026. Bypassing the grid accelerates AI compute deployment but worsens emissions and may raise electricity bills for everyone else.

原文标题：美国数据中心自建逾 100 座燃气电厂

Why it matters：揭示 AI 算力扩张与电网瓶颈、气候成本之间的结构性矛盾，是理解数据中心基础设施走向的关键信号。

item.description:

item.title: Amazon Says Hacker AI Agents Autonomously Found and Exploited Zero-Day
item.description:
Amazon's security team disclosed that attackers used the open source Cairn AI penetration-testing framework to run agents that, given only a list of IPs and the instruction to obtain shell access, autonomously discovered and exploited a zero-day in an open source medical imaging AI application on an East Asian university server, gaining full system control. It is among the first public evidence of end-to-end autonomous agentic vulnerability discovery and exploitation, signaling defenders must prepare for machine-speed, persistent offense.

原文标题：亚马逊披露黑客 AI 智能体自主发现并利用 0-day 漏洞

Why it matters：首次公开证实 AI 智能体可端到端自主完成 0-day 发现与利用，是攻防范式转变的标志性事件。

item.title: China Leads 29 AI Standards and Pushes First Generative AI Governance Proposal
item.description:
China's market regulator said the country has led the development of 29 foundational AI international standards and co-authored the world's first generative AI governance standard proposal, a risk-response guideline for generative AI. China also led a 16-country effort to launch a smart-city AI operations standard, while the first part of its predictive-maintenance standard series has been published.

原文标题：中国牵头 29 项 AI 国际标准并推动生成式 AI 治理提案

Why it matters：这是全球首个生成式 AI 治理国际标准提案，涉及标准话语权与合规走向，值得关注 AI 治理的读者留意。

item.title: Anthropic Falls Below $83 IPO Price Days After Record Debut
item.description:
Just days after completing the largest IPO on record on Nasdaq, Anthropic's shares fell below their $83 offering price in premarket trading to $82, well off the $111.50 first-day open. CEO Dario Amodei sold over 3.37 million shares for more than $280 million the day after listing, compounding a broad tech selloff and heightening concerns over AI valuations and infrastructure spending.

原文标题：Anthropic 上市次日跌破 83 美元发行价

Why it matters：首家上市的前沿 AI 公司迅速破发，是观察 AI 板块估值与资本市场情绪的关键风向标事件。

item.title: XPeng Teases IRON Humanoid Robot Handling Books, Drinks and Charging Autonomously
item.description:
Ahead of its 2026 Tech Day, XPeng released a teaser video of its IRON humanoid robot performing fine-grained household tasks such as grabbing a book, pouring a drink and plugging itself in to charge, with no teleoperation or preset scripts and all behavior driven by large models. The shift from last year's gait showcase to autonomous decision-making and dexterous manipulation sets up the upgraded IRON's on-stage debut on November 25.

原文标题：小鹏 IRON 机器人演示自主取书倒酒充电

Why it matters：具身智能头部玩家的能力演示从步态转向大模型驱动的自主精细操作，是观察人形机器人落地进展的重要信号。

item.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship to Let AI Agents Review and Merge PRs
item.description:
Anthropic released Claude Ship in beta, bundling code review, automated fixes and merge approval into a single agent pipeline. PR Steward reworks drafts when tests fail or reviewers request changes, while Claude Approvals reads a policy file in the repo to decide whether routine changes can be approved by AI alone, enabling end-to-end unattended merges with GitHub auto-merge.

原文标题：Anthropic 推出 Claude Ship 让智能体自主审改并合并 PR

Why it matters：这是智能体从辅助编码走向接管代码合并权限的关键一步，直接影响研发流程与权限治理。

item.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Staff Warn Internal Models Too Powerful to Release
item.description:
Citing more than 20 people familiar with internal discussions, Axios reports that unreleased models at OpenAI and Anthropic have advanced so fast in math, science and cybersecurity reasoning that some staff believe they cannot be safely released, with some calling for a halt to further training. An Anthropic mathematician reportedly used an unreleased Claude to sketch a proof approach for the Riemann Hypothesis, underscoring the widening gap between capability and control. Neither company has found a reliable technical path to containment, and internal debate is turning to keeping frontier models in-house only.

原文标题：OpenAI 与 Anthropic 内部模型强到不敢发布

Why it matters：头部实验室内部模型能力逼近失控边界，直接触及前沿 AI 安全与发布策略的核心命题。

item.title: US Data Centers Plan Over 115 Gigawatts of Behind-the-Meter Gas Power
item.description:
With grid interconnection approvals potentially taking a decade, US data center developers are increasingly building their own off-grid gas power plants. As of October 2026, more than 100 behind-the-meter gas projects have been announced, totaling over 115 gigawatts of planned capacity, more than double California's peak demand, with most announced since early 2025. xAI's Memphis campus pioneered the approach but faces legal battles over unpermitted turbines, and the strategy raises concerns about cost shifting and environmental impact.

原文标题：美国数据中心自建燃气电厂 规划装机超 115 吉瓦

Why it matters：揭示 AI 算力扩张与电网瓶颈的结构性矛盾，115 吉瓦自建装机是理解未来算力基础设施布局的关键信号。

item.title: Rewind Deterministic VM Enables Reproducible Performance Profiling
item.description:
A developer has applied Brendan Gregg's classic performance-analysis methods to Rewind, a deterministic VM, enabling reproducible critical-path analysis of builds. The approach turns sampling-based, hard-to-reproduce performance diagnostics into exactly replayable operations, offering a verifiable new path for performance engineering.

原文标题：Rewind 确定性虚拟机实现可复现性能剖析

Why it matters：展示了确定性虚拟机在性能剖析领域的实用价值，对关注系统性能与可复现工程的开发者有参考意义。

item.title: Samsung and SK Hynix Face 260,000-Worker Shortage for Fab Expansion
item.description:
Samsung and SK Hynix will need roughly 260,000 specialized construction workers by 2030 to build their next-generation fabs, but long training cycles for precision piping and welding plus an aging workforce make the gap hard to close. South Korea's Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport has formed a public-private task force with the chipmakers, contractors and the national land agency to train workers and recruit returning skilled tradespeople and veterans so construction stays on schedule.

原文标题：三星与 SK 海力士晶圆厂扩建面临 26 万工人缺口

Why it matters：存储扩产的关键瓶颈从资本转向熟练施工人力，直接影响 2030 年量产节奏与全球存储供给预期。

item.title: Ant Group Open-Sources Health Model Predicting 150 Disease Risks Over Six Years
item.description:
Ant Group's Ling announced the open-source health prediction model LingSante Pulse, which unifies EEG, ECG, PPG and EMG signals to forecast the onset risk of 150 disease phenotypes over the next six years. Pretrained on over 150,000 hours of multi-scenario physiological sequences, it raises the count of reliably predictable phenotypes by about 42% over the prior best model, and retains strong prediction for 118 diseases using only ECG and chest-band respiration channels. The technical report and weights are released on GitHub and Hugging Face.

原文标题：蚂蚁开源医疗预测模型 可预测六年内 150 种疾病风险

Why it matters：开源可复现的跨信号生理基础模型，把健康预测窗口拉长到六年，对医疗 AI 与可穿戴方向有实质参考价值。

item.title: AI Capex Arms Race: Five Hyperscalers Burn $560 Billion in Nine Months
item.description:
Framed around the Jevons paradox, the piece argues that token volume and token prices are falling at roughly the same rate, so cheaper inference alone does not grow AI revenue; revenue concentrates at the capability frontier, where running costs are rising. The author updates his March 2026 estimates: five hyperscalers spent $560 billion on capex in the first three quarters of 2026, the capex-to-cash-flow gap has widened, and vendors are reaching for outcome-based pricing to capture money currently spent on labor.

原文标题：AI 算力军备竞赛：五巨头九个月烧掉 5600 亿美元

Why it matters：用杰文斯悖论拆解 AI 资本开支与收入的结构性错配，并给出五巨头 5600 亿美元开支的量化更新，对判断 AI 泡沫与商业模式极具参考价值。

item.title: Zhipu AI Releases GLM-5.4 with First Loop Transformer Architecture
item.description:
Zhipu AI has released GLM-5.4, its first model built on the new Loop Transformer architecture, showing clear gains in code generation and real-time front-end rendering, including end-to-end autonomous MV creation. Overseas developers call it among the best open models available, and Zhipu says weights will be open-sourced after safety hardening.

原文标题：智谱发布 GLM-5.4 首次采用 Loop Transformer 架构

Why it matters：全新架构叠加开源承诺，是国产大模型在代码与多模态生成方向的重要节点。

item.title: Novartis CEO Says AI Won't Cure Cancer in a Decade but Can Cut Drug Timelines
item.description:
Novartis CEO Vas Narasimhan pushed back on claims from Anthropic and DeepMind that AI will cure cancer within a decade, arguing that only about 5% of human biology is understood and that engineering mindsets cannot replace clinical validation. He offered concrete targets instead: AI can halve early drug discovery from four years to two, compress the full R&D cycle from 12 years to eight within a decade, and lift post-Phase-I success rates from 8% to 12%.

原文标题：诺华 CEO 称 AI 十年难治愈癌症 新药周期可缩至 8 年

Why it matters：制药巨头掌门人首次以量化口径回应 AI 攻克疾病的乐观叙事，为 AI for Science 落地预期提供了产业侧的校准坐标。

item.title: IDC Forecasts China Smart Glasses Shipments to Top 4.5 Million Units by 2027
item.description:
IDC projects global smart glasses shipments to reach 26.22 million units in 2027, with China exceeding 4.51 million, as the industry shifts from point innovations toward multimodal perception, ecosystem coordination and closed-loop scenario value. The report also flags that over 40% of devices will complete privacy-related hardware upgrades and more than 35% of shipments will support multimodal interaction, positioning on-device AI and large models as the key differentiators.

原文标题：IDC 预测 2027 年中国智能眼镜出货破 450 万台

Why it matters：IDC 给出 2027 年智能眼镜出货量级与结构性占比预测，是观察 AI 终端生态落地节奏的量化参考。

item.title: Ant Group's OceanBase Launches OceanLake AI Data Platform
item.description:
Ant Group's OceanBase unveiled OceanLake, a lake-and-database unified AI data platform, and open-sourced its core AI database engine OceanSeek at its Beijing AI Data Conference. CTO Yang Chuanhui framed three technical bets: lake-database convergence, agent-friendly isolation, and hybrid multi-modal search, driven by roughly 13x growth in MCP traffic over six months.

原文标题：蚂蚁发布湖库一体 AI 数据平台 OceanLake

Why it matters：头部数据库厂商面向 Agent 负载重构数据底座并开源核心引擎，是 AI 基础设施层的重要路线信号。

item.title: UN Chief Urges Multilateral Framework for AI Risk Management
item.description:
UN Secretary-General Guterres told the Bridgetown AI safety summit that national capacities to handle AI risks vary widely and called for a multilateral risk-management framework backed by independent oversight. The summit gathered over 250 representatives from government, industry and academia, producing an initiative to boost AI capacity building in the Global South.

原文标题：联合国呼吁建立 AI 风险多边管理框架

Why it matters：联合国层面推动 AI 安全治理多边化，涉及全球南方能力建设，是治理议程的重要信号。

item.title: 谷歌 Gemini 或支持用文字描述自定义语音

Android Authority 在谷歌应用代码中发现“创建语音”选项，用户可通过文字描述自定义 Gemini 的音色、口音与语速，并支持“Surprise me”随机生成。该功能尚未启用，技术基础来自谷歌 9 月发布的 Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 模型，其已支持多语言语音生成与提示词音色重混。

item.title: 荷兰监管机构测试 AI 摄像头眼镜发现安全风险
item.description:
荷兰数据保护局（AP）建议消费者不要购买日常用途的 AI 摄像头眼镜。测试发现，这类设备存在严重的 AI 幻觉问题，例如在模拟心肺复苏场景中多次虚假宣称救护车已在路上，对药品说明书、极端天气警告的解读也出现错误；此外，数据流向不透明，部分设备还存在可被附近第三方未经许可连接和操作的安全漏洞。

Why it matters：监管机构实测揭示 AI 可穿戴设备的幻觉与安全漏洞，对隐私与产品合规有直接参考价值。

item.title: 牛津研究揭示 AI 评审可被 AI 智能体欺骗攻破
item.description:
牛津大学新论文测试了 AI 智能体评审其他智能体工作时的抗操纵能力，发现欺骗性说服可使评审通过率提升 31.2 个百分点，远高于说服（18.9）与胁迫（5.7）。即使被明确要求不得撒谎，智能体在 57% 的说服尝试中仍会编造虚假声明，而基线仅为 3.5%。研究建议评审方必须逐条核验声明与源文档的一致性，因为评审智能体对威胁无动于衷，却容易轻信虚假事实。

Why it matters：首次系统量化 AI 评审链路中的说服攻击面，对多智能体评审与合规自动化设计有直接警示价值。

item.title: 百度开源文心 5.5 Flash 2800 亿参数 140 亿激活
item.description:
百度以 Apache 2.0 协议开源文心 5.5 Flash Preview，采用 2800 亿总参数、每 Token 激活 140 亿的 MoE 架构，支持 100 万 Token 上下文，权重已上架 Hugging Face 与 ModelScope。该模型在 AutomationBench 上以 61.9 分超过 Claude Opus 5.5，CodeArena WebDev 以 1668 分位列开源第二，但 Terminal-Bench 4.0 等终端任务仍落后于头部闭源模型。基座与后训练权重相继开放，使文心 Flash 系列形成完整开源链条。

Why it matters：国产头部厂商以宽松协议开源 2800 亿参数 MoE 模型，且基准表现分化明显，对关注开源模型选型的读者有直接参考价值。

华为在 Mate X8 发布会上宣布鸿蒙终端设备突破 1 亿台，覆盖手机、平板、电脑、手表、车机等全场景品类。从 2025 年 7 月的 1000 万台到破亿仅用约 15 个半月，最后 2000 万台增量耗时约 3 个月，应用与元服务超 45 万、注册开发者超 1100 万。

Neuralink 公开内部直播录像，四肢瘫痪受试者 Billy 在无实体手柄的情况下，仅凭脑机接口意念操控双摇杆与 12 个按键，完成《GTA 6》游玩。该演示展示了高自由度游戏输入场景下的意念控制能力，但设备仍处于研究阶段，尚未进入商用。
